name: Strangely Marked Box
summary: A Strangely Marked Box is a piece of cargo discovered inside the harnesses strapped to dead sea turtles along the Darkshore coastline. Its mysterious exterior bears the runic script of the serpentine naga, offering night elf scholars proof that these sea creatures did not strand themselves by accident.

sections.title: Trophies of the Deep
sections.body: While several giant sea turtles and sea creatures simply wash ashore along Darkshore's mist-veiled beaches, others tell a far more ominous tale. Scattered carcasses bear the splintered remnants of riding harnesses and abandoned carriages bound straight to their shells. Within the ruins of these buckled contraptions lie sealed containers covered in foreign, sinuous runes. Scavenging Greymist murlocs frequently take up residence in the hollow ribcages and broken wagons, picking at the carrion and guarding whatever remnants were left behind.

sections.title: Evidence of Naga Expansion
sections.body: When brought to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, a researcher representing the Temple of the Moon in Auberdine, the markings on the box reveal their true origin. The script and the strapped carriages belong to the naga, who use massive turtles as beasts of burden to ferry logistical supplies and war equipment onto dry land. The discovery of these supply boxes confirms that the naga are deliberately operating along the northern shores and driving mounts south toward Ashenvale, prompting the priesthood in Auberdine to ship the relics directly to Darnassus for further study.

faq.q: Where is the Strangely Marked Box found?
aliases: where to find strangely marked box
faq.answer: The box is recovered from abandoned carriages strapped to the shells of beached sea turtle carcasses along the coast of Darkshore. These carcasses are often surrounded and defended by Greymist murlocs feeding on the carrion.

faq.q: Who made the Strangely Marked Box?
faq.answer: The box and its inscriptions were created by the naga. They affix cargo carriages to living sea turtles to haul provisions, arms, and equipment out of the ocean depths and onto the shores of Kalimdor.

faq.q: Who wants this box in Auberdine?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, a researcher working in Auberdine on behalf of the Temple of the Moon, collects the box to analyze the strange beachings and understand the growing naga threat.

faq.q: Why were the sea turtles carrying these boxes?
faq.answer: The naga domesticate or enslave giant sea turtles as beasts of burden, strapping harnesses and carriages to their backs to transport military materiel and supplies along coastal regions toward southern targets like Ashenvale.

faq.q: What happens to the box after giving it to Gwennyth?
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde forwards the box and the rest of the coastal survey findings up to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus so the night elf leadership can study the extent of the naga incursion.

angles.text: Finding naga supply boxes lashed to native sea turtles along Darkshore warns the kaldorei that their ancient, mutated kin are systematically pushing ashore from the Great Sea.
Securing relics from the shore aids the Temple of the Moon's scholars in Auberdine as they work to safeguard the coast from marine corruption.
